commit.message:
test: speed up local and CI E2E verification (#1001)

* test: speed up local and CI E2E verification

* ci: preserve Build check while preparing E2E independently

* test: prepare shared OpenCode binary before E2E workers

* test: bound OpenCode session creation and server cleanup

The first OpenCode session installs the config-dir plugins' npm
dependencies, which takes about 4s locally and exceeds the 5s request
budget under parallel load. After the abort, OpenCode ignores SIGTERM,
so cleanup awaited close until the 60s test timeout and leaked the
server. Give session creation 20s and force-kill after 3s on cleanup.

* docs: tighten E2E guidance in CONTRIBUTING

* docs: tighten E2E notes in CI setup guide

* docs: tighten remaining E2E guidance
